limitations: Probe calls are not PSI duration; nested calls and observer effects remain possible.
Interval membership is temporal correlation, not causal attribution.
Counters are sequential reads and accounting can lag; some/full interval increments need not align.
Host counters include unrelated workloads. Historical samples lack I/O and host counters.
Trace scope begins after Python imports and ends after observer serialization; memory observation has a narrower window.
